test.description:
This test verifies creation of a Data type custom field using the creation modal and its correct behavior across the application.

* Creating a Data type custom field 
* Verifying that the field appears in the Fields list

** OKR Detail, Overview table, Side Panel, creation dialog, and tree view
* Verifying that the custom field is available for all OKR types (Strategic Theme, Objective, Key Result)
* Verifying that a value can be selected during OKR creation

Labels: spm-mikolaj-tc

Description:

* Creating a Data type custom field 
* Verifying that the field appears in the Fields list
* Verifying that the field is visible in all relevant places:
** OKR Detail, Overview table, Side Panel, creation dialog, and tree view
* Verifying that the custom field is available for all OKR types (Strategic Theme, Objective, Key Result)
* Verifying that a value can be selected during OKR creation
* Verifying that the selected value is saved correctly and displayed in all supported views

Steps:
1. Navigate to OKR settings → Fields of boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-6123 SPM - OKR - Creating Data type custom field
   Expected: Fields settings page is displayed.
2. Click on "Create new" button.
   Expected: "Create custom field" modal is displayed.
3. Type field name, select Data field type. Click Create button
   Data: * fieldName: Data field
   Expected: Data field is successfully created. New field appears in the "Your custom fields" list.
Field name, type and "Used in" values are displayed correctly
4. Open Overview → click Add → Create strategic theme
   Expected: Creation modal is displayed. Data field is visible in the OKR creation modal with default value "Not set"
5. Enter strategic theme name, set period and select value in Data field. Click Create
   Data: * stName: Strategic theme 1
* period: Y2026
* data field value: 05/10/2026
   Expected: Strategic theme is created and visible in tree view. Data field is visible in the right-side with correct value.
6. Click Add + button next to strategic theme and add objective

7. Enter Objective name, set period and select value in Data field. Click Create
   Data: * objectiveName: Objective 1
* period: Y2026
* data field value: 05/10/2026

8. Click Add + button next to Objective and add Key result

9. Enter Key reslut name, set period and select value in Data field. Click Create
   Data: * key-resultName: KR 1
* period: Y2026
* data field value: 05/10/2026

10. Open Overview and navigate to Data field
   Expected: Data field is visible in the Overview table for Strategic Theme, Objective and Key result with correct name and values.
11. Click on the grey area of the Strategic theme row
   Expected: Side panel is opened on the right side and displays details of the selected Strategic theme. Data field is visible with correct name and value.
12. Click on the grey area of the Objective row
   Expected: Side panel is opened on the right side and displays details of the selected Objective. Data field is visible with correct name and value.
13. Click on the grey area of the Key-result row
   Expected: Side panel is opened on the right side and displays details of the selected Key result. Data field is visible with correct name and value.
14. Open Strategic theme in the detail page and navigate to the Info section
   Expected: Detail page is opened. Data field is visible with correct name and value.
15. Open Objective in the detail page and navigate to the Info section
   Expected: Detail page is opened. Data field is visible with correct name and value.
16. Open Key-result in the detail page and navigate to the Info section
   Expected: Detail page is opened. Data field is visible with correct name and value.
